dedupe_keys.name: arcep tchad telecom market observatory dashboards and annual reports chad

description: ARCEP Tchad, the regulator of electronic communications and post in Chad, runs a telecom market observatory on its website. It offers dashboards (tableaux de bord) for mobile telephony, fixed telephony, internet, demography and postal services, and annual observatory reports on the telecommunications market for 2011 to 2015 (PDF on the site) and 2018 to 2020 (hosted on Google Drive), plus a 2014 report on the internet market and survey reports on operator switching (2014) and the telephony market (2013). Coverage is national; resolution is per operator and per year. Format and access: web dashboards and PDF reports; the dashboards did not render readable figures from the cloud. Licence: not stated. Free. Caveats: the latest annual report found is for 2020, some reports sit on Google Drive, not the regulator's server, the bulletin page answered 403 and the site resets connections intermittently. Simulation uses: operator subscriber and traffic figures for telecom capacity and resilience analysis in the Sahel. Related records: comparable to the AGER São Tomé telecom statistical indicators and the ECTEL Eastern Caribbean sector review.
